evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Your move out date would be Saturday October 3rd and moving from 6940 Sofa court in China spring going to 308 loss olives lane in liberty hill... You're moving from a 2600 square foot home but going to a 1600 square foot house
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Other than price. What are you most worried about for this upcoming noon? [asked after packing/downsizing probing had started]
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep followed up on concerns about having to help movers, wall damage from prior moves, and needing hands-off service — 'I don't want to have to hold people's hands to do this. I expect them to do their job and get it done well and then just not damage anything.' Amy acknowledged each and dug into the safe weight multiple times, the couch dimensions and configuration, and whether the door could be removed from the safe.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Rep acknowledged damage concerns and timing concerns but did not summarize back all three concerns as a complete reflection before moving into solutions
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (2600 sq ft home to 1600 sq ft house), furniture inventory (large sectional couch in 3 pieces, bed frame, dressers, crib, safe upstairs, two deep freezers, smoker, ~30-40 boxes in totes and cardboard), special considerations (safe needs two guys minimum, couch is heavy and in pieces, daughter has two dressers, one bedroom full of boxes), floor/stories (safe upstairs needing to come downstairs), additional stops (none mentioned)
evidence_quotes.packing_services: Do you need help packing or would you have the boxes ready to go? — Cody: Boxes will be ready to go.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_offer: Would you be able to do a quick visual walkthrough... I'd like to see if... with what you told me sounds like we can fit everything in one truck. But... I would like to double-check the sizes... if do we need to add a third mover... That's the main reason I want to do the virtual walkthrough and whenever you guys are available I can do anytime tomorrow from 9:00 to five

top_strength: Amy gathered comprehensive logistics details (furniture, special items, dimensions, weights) and routed the call appropriately to a virtual walkthrough when the home size and complexity required it, rather than attempting to quote blind.
coaching_note: Section 1: Amy never delivered the quid pro quo framing ('10–15 minutes, dependable quote, does that sound good?') before beginning probing—she jumped straight into details confirmation; and Section 2: after identifying concerns, she moved into solutions (blankets, insurance, W-2 employees) without first reflecting back what she heard ('So what I'm hearing is: you want hands-off service, you're worried about damage from prior bad experiences, and you need a crew that does the job well without you having to supervise') to confirm she understood the full picture before pivoting.
